name: Credential Access
description: Signs of credential theft: SAM handles, password-hash access, DSRM password changes, Credential Manager backup and restore, and local account and group enumeration. LSASS memory access is Sysmon 10 with lsass.exe as the target image; Sysmon 10 is not included because it logs every process opening another (1.6 million events in the test logs): search for lsass.exe within Sysmon 10 instead.
author: EventHawk (Microsoft documentation, SANS, Sigma)

event_descriptions.4782: Password hash of an account accessed
event_descriptions.4794: Attempt to set the Directory Services Restore Mode password
event_descriptions.5377: Credential Manager credentials restored from a backup
